calls.reason: The forecast has no deadline. Rentosertib's Phase IIa result and its September 2026 Phase III start are progress, but it remains unapproved and nothing shows broad impact on drug design yet.
The only support is one paper's remark that ChatGPT exceeded expectations, plus a 2022 survey of researchers. Neither measures whether most people's expectations were beaten.
The claim is hedged, and the packet's only item is GPT-4 passing a text-only radiology board exam. No evaluation compares image reading with use of case records against radiologists.

DFRLab and Recorded Future document AI-assisted election campaigns. The market half rests on one Chinese case involving two articles, not a wholesale automated campaign, so the combined forecast is only partly shown.

The CBS transcript and O'Toole's correction show Pelley gave Bard the six words as a prompt. No earlier source was found for Bard's continuation, so the example does not show the parroting Marcus alleged.

The claim is loose and partly opinion. The Wu et al. counterfactual study found performance drops sharply on unfamiliar task variants but also some real generalization, so the evidence is mixed on how much is mimicry.
